usefulness.rationale: The dossier gives a coherent, well-sourced picture of Achim Steiner: Brazilian-German national (b. 1961), UNEP Executive Director 2006–2016, Oxford Martin School Director 2016–2017, UNDP Administrator 2017–2025, and current roles (Senior Fellow Oxford Martin School since Jan 2026, Chair of the Hamburg Sustainability Conference since Oct 2025, several board/council seats), plus education, awards, and a stated policy perspective. A reader learns who he is and what he actually did. Currency is, however, internally inconsistent: the overview/career sections carry several present-tense UNDP-era claims ('heads the United Nations Development Programme', 'UNDP Administrator', 'head of the UNDP', 'Vice-Chair of the UN Sustainable Development Group') that the retained account itself ends in June 2025, and other claims correctly mark him 'former administrator'. Uncertainty is signalled via contested/stale statuses rather than explicit statements of what is unknown, and no dossier claim corresponds to the 'personal-sdgs' unjustified conclusion. Meeting prep is possible from the current-role claims, but a reader leading with the overview could wrongly greet him as the sitting UNDP Administrator.
